content:
Starting from iOS 26.4, Apple began supporting conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting from iOS 27. That iPhone software update is currently in beta and will officially launch in September.

Meanwhile, the fourth third-party AI chatbot app has added support for Apple CarPlay: Meta AI.

The Meta AI iPhone app now supports Apple CarPlay — but with one caveat

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps that support CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI on CarPlay appears to be only a limited test for now.

Although the iPhone app has shown up on CarPlay, launching it may display an "unsupported" message.

At least for me, launching the CarPlay app shows the message: "The Meta AI experience is not currently supported for your account."

I tried signing up for a paid Meta AI account to see if the CarPlay feature required a subscription. However, the message inside the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Actual experience may vary.

Regardless, it's encouraging to see CarPlay add a fourth mainstream chatbot app even before Siri AI officially rolls out to everyone.

This is CarPlay's main advantage: integrating existing iPhone apps into your car. Built-in infotainment systems simply cannot offer the same breadth of choice.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also landed on the Mac platform. The desktop version is far more powerful than the iPhone and iPad apps.
